title: Classification Search - WCIRB California
publisher: Workers' Compensation Insurance Rating Bureau of California (WCIRB)
claims: Classification Search helps users locate classifications based on keywords that are part of, or commonly associated with, classification phraseologies.

The page directs users to the Insurance Commissioner's rules regarding the Standard Classification System in Part 3, Standard Classification System, of the California Workers' Compensation Uniform Statistical Reporting Plan-1995.
